author: META_B
scope: Read-only comparison of prior independent-reference hashes, locally available path history, final manifest/adjudication/closeout references and the new A preservation receipt. No source/solution/image rereview, no Git mutation, no raw worker overwrite.
findings: finalAuthorArtifactReadback is an author-payload reference layer, not a hash of the later integrated Git file. The declared review hash is also recorded as rootIntegration.workerArtifactSha256; individual files explicitly preserve this distinction.
The current integrated review/four-slot files match all 24 corresponding final-artifact-manifest records. Their differing 24 author references predate this resume and are preserved without rewriting.

For five review payloads, removing only explicit root wrapper fields from the current JSON and serializing it exactly reconstructs the declared author SHA-256. This identifies their payload content, but is not recovery of an independently stored historical Git blob.

The remaining seven author-review payloads and all twelve author-four-slot payloads were not recovered exactly. Their full field differences and sample-content invariance cannot be asserted from the recorded author hashes.

No exact declared author payload was found as a readable historical Git blob in the bounded path history. Several older commit:path reads were unavailable locally; no broad history search or object hydration was attempted after the bounded audit.
The prior final-adjudications document records three integrationPattern changes and no sampleSlotAmendments. This is a stored past statement, distinct from fresh byte verification.

A new preservation receipt separately binds the preserved 36 sample UID/ordinal and current source fingerprints. Its current-source binding and preserved-baseline guarantees remain useful even where original author-payload byte provenance cannot be fully recovered. It is not a new independent semantic review or a quality PASS.

referenceRoles.priorIndependentReview: Preserved prior sample decisions/notes and author-file reference hashes; no silent upgrade to current integrated-file hash attestation.
referenceRoles.finalArtifactManifest: Exact hashes of final integrated artifacts; all 24 requested review/four-slot entries match current files.
referenceRoles.finalVerification: Stored 2026-11-14 mechanical verification snapshot with 36 sample ordinals and source/protected-field results; not a fresh semantic approval.
referenceRoles.closeoutReview: Stored final integrated review hashes and document consistency scope; explicitly denies new quality approval.
referenceRoles.newAPreservationReceipt: Fresh baseline/current byte preservation and current source UID/fingerprint binding for the 36 preserved samples; separate evidence from old author-file hashes.

newAPreservationReceipt.reportedGuarantee: source12/UID286/old48 byte preservation; 36 sampled current UID/ordinal/QBODY/QFULL/question-hash bindings; declared historical hash mismatches retained.

limitations: Exact original author files were not independently recovered as Git blobs. The complete semantics of missing historical bytes cannot be certified unchanged.
Exact reconstruction of five JSON author payloads is a narrowly proved SHA identity, not a claim of a new historical commit or new independent review.
The audit does not resolve SOURCE_ONLY method evidence, reviewed_hold solution authority, registry/binding approval or content-debt issues.
Do not replace old author hashes with current integrated hashes; retain both roles and the new A receipt.
